findings.description: Checkbox wording is read from the form when the feed runs; a feed run later sends the label current then. Consent fields use the entry's own text.
findings.recommendation: Accept for 1.3.0; note for Broadcaster's consent record.

findings.description: Only visitor-sent wording is the consent .2, protected by Gravity Forms state validation (probe: tampered state refused). Sent as JSON.
findings.recommendation: Broadcaster escapes the wording wherever it shows it.

New data sent is disclosed in readme Privacy and Settings > Privacy text; new log line holds ids only; nothing new stored.
